review_candidates.title: Junior Developer Process Transformation
review_candidates.description: Job Summary: The Developer - Process Transformation is responsible for identifying manual, inefficient, spreadsheet-based, or fragmented operational processes and translating them into practical interim digital solutions using Microsoft 365, Copilot, Power Platform, SQL, and approved enterprise tools. The role combines hands-on development capability with strong process analysis, Level 2 operational understanding, and DevOps discipline to deliver controlled, supportable, and measurable improvements while larger strategic platforms or core system changes are being planned or implemented. The role is expected to work closely with business users, IT operations, application support, architecture, security, compliance, and project teams to design, build, test, deploy, document, and support lightweight transformation solutions that reduce manual effort, improve visibility, strengthen process control, and accelerate business outcomes. Main Responsibilities: Assess manual, inefficient, high-volume, or control-sensitive business processes and identify opportunities for practical automation, digitisation, or interim tooling. Work with business stakeholders to document current-state processes, pain points, manual hand-offs, spreadsheets, duplicate data entry, approval bottlenecks, and operational risks. Translate transformation opportunities into clear user stories, functional specifications, process maps, data requirements, acceptance criteria, and measurable expected benefits. Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain interim business solutions using Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Forms, Lists, and Copilot-enabled productivity patterns. Use SQL, preferably PL/SQL, to analyse datasets, validate data quality, support reporting needs, build controlled data extracts, troubleshoot issues, and support integration or reconciliation activities. Collaborate with architecture and senior developers to ensure interim solutions are aligned with technology standards, security requirements, data protection obligations, and long-term platform direction. Apply DevOps practices including version control discipline, environment management, release notes, deployment checklists, backlog tracking, defect logging, and controlled promotion of changes. Provide Level 2 operational support for solutions delivered, including issue triage, root cause analysis, user support, monitoring of failures, minor enhancements, and escalation to specialist teams where required. Build dashboards, trackers, workflow views, and exception reports that improve business visibility, operational follow-up, and management control. Support prototyping and proof-of-concept activities to demonstrate how Copilot, Power Platform, and Microsoft 365 can improve productivity and reduce manual work. Prepare user guidance, support documentation, technical notes, test evidence, and operational handover materials to ensure solutions are maintainable beyond initial delivery. Promote safe adoption of low-code and AI-assisted tools by ensuring appropriate governance, access control, auditability, documentation, and lifecycle management. Accountabilities: Accountable for delivering approved interim transformation solutions that create measurable reductions in manual effort, processing time, rework, or operational risk. Responsible for ensuring that solutions are built in a controlled, secure, documented, and supportable manner using approved Microsoft 365, Power Platform, SQL, and DevOps practices. Accountable for the quality and traceability of requirements, testing, deployment evidence, user guidance, and operational handover documentation. Responsible for ensuring delivered solutions can be supported at Level 2, including clear troubleshooting steps, ownership model, known limitations, and escalation paths. Accountable for collaborating effectively with business owners, IT operations, architecture, information security, data protection, compliance, and project stakeholders. Responsible for identifying when an interim solution is no longer appropriate and should be replaced, retired, integrated, or migrated into a strategic platform. Skills and Qualifications: Diploma or degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Development, Business Technology, or a related technical discipline. Strong working experience in SQL, ideally PL/SQL, including querying, joins, stored procedures, data validation, troubleshooting, extracts, and reconciliation activities. Hands-on experience developing or supporting business applications, automation scripts, workflow tools, reporting solutions, or operational support utilities. Practical exposure to Microsoft 365 and Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint Lists/Libraries, Teams, Forms, and preferably Dataverse. Good understanding of Level 2 Operations, including incident triage, problem analysis, user support, defect investigation, monitoring, and operational handover. Good overlap into DevOps practices, including backlog management, version control, controlled releases, testing discipline, deployment documentation, and supportability considerations. Ability to analyse business processes, challenge inefficient ways of working, and convert improvement opportunities into pragmatic technology-enabled solutions. Working knowledge of data protection, information security, access control, auditability, and governance considerations for low-code and internally developed solutions. Ability to prepare clear documentation, user guides, technical notes, test evidence, and operational support materials. Strong communication skills, with the ability to work with business users, technical teams, vendors, and control functions. Microsoft Power Platform Fundamentals, Power Platform App Maker, Azure DevOps, ITIL, or database-related certifications would be considered an asset. KPIs Measurable KPIs: Process efficiency gains: Deliver approved automations or interim solutions that reduce manual processing effort by an agreed target, typically 20%–40% for selected processes. Transformation pipeline delivery: Complete at least 80% of assigned process improvement items within agreed sprint, monthly, or project timelines. Automation adoption: Achieve sustained usage of delivered solutions by agreed business users, with at least 75% active adoption within the first three months of go-live where applicable. Operational stability: Maintain agreed availability and reliability of supported interim solutions, with priority incidents triaged within agreed Level 2 support SLAs. Defect leakage: Limit high-impact defects discovered after go-live by ensuring adequate testing, peer review, and business validation before release. Data quality and reconciliation: Deliver SQL-based extracts, checks, or reconciliations with documented validation evidence and minimal rework following business or technical review. Documentation completeness: Maintain complete requirements, design notes, test evidence, release notes, user guidance, and support handover documentation for at least 95% of delivered solutions. Governance compliance: Ensure 100% of delivered solutions follow approved access control, data protection, security, naming, environment, and lifecycle management standards. Support responsiveness: Resolve or progress agreed Level 2 incidents, service requests, and minor enhancements within defined turnaround times. Stakeholder satisfaction: Achieve positive feedback from business owners and IT stakeholders on responsiveness, clarity, usability, and quality of delivered transformation support. Salary Bracket € 25K - € 30K Benefits: + Flexible working hours + Richmond Foundation Sessions + Gym in Premises + Birthday Leave + Health Insurance + Life Insurance + Personal Accident Insurance + Canteen Allowance + Transport Allowance + Longer Maternity / Paternal leave + Children Sick Leave + Pension Plan Incentive + Active Ageing Incentive + Study / Exam Leave + Sports and Cultural Leave + Sponsorship for Training + Canteen Facility + Medical Services + VDU Testing + Sta􀆯 Discounts + Performance Bonus + Compassionate Transfer of Leave Scheme

Every year millions of people come to our site to get a fixed-price quote. We’ve installed over 200,000 products so far, while establishing a network of more than 15,000 professionally accredited installers. The role We are looking for a hands-on mid-level DevOps engineer to help build and run the platform our business depends on. You will not just keep the lights on; you will work with others to shape how we build, deploy and operate our infrastructure. The foundations are in place, but we are growing and evolving, so there is plenty to still define; you will be a key member of the team driving this forward. You will write infrastructure as code, own pipelines, and work directly with product engineers to make shipping software fast, safe and secure. You will be trusted to pick up work without being told, diagnose incidents and create solutions that fit the problem. Responsibilities Infrastructure and automation Builds and maintains our AWS infrastructure as code, treating infrastructure with the same care as application code — reviewed, tested and versioned. Optimise our platform and containerised workloads on ECS and Fargate, including scaling, cost and service health. Automates repeat work rather than absorbing it, removing toil from the team instead of quietly living with it. Owns and improves our CircleCI and GitHub Actions pipelines so builds, tests and deployments are quick and predictable. Writes and maintains runbooks so operational knowledge sits with the team rather than with one person. Reliability and observability Set up and tune monitoring and alerting in New Relic so problems are spotted before customers raise them, and so alerts mean something when they fire. Takes part in incident response, helps establish root cause, and sees follow-up fixes through to completion rather than leaving them on a list. Contributes to backup, resilience and disaster recovery work, including testing that recovery actually works. Security and compliance Applies security fundamentals day to day: least privilege IAM, secrets handling, patching, network segmentation and certificate management. Supports evidence gathering and control work for our security and compliance obligations. Ways of working Works closely with product engineering, support and security so platform decisions reflect real needs rather than assumptions. Is collaborative by default, creating solutions together or seeking feedback to learn and validate. Skills Solid hands-on experience with core AWS services, and comfortable designing cloud native systems built on containers, serverless components and automation Able to read, write and maintain Go, used here mainly for internal tooling Practical experience building and maintaining infrastructure as code with Terraform Or Pulumi (Pulumi Preferred) Confident with Git workflows, pull request reviews and GitHub Actions for CI/CD Experience configuring and integrating off-the-shelf vendor products as well as internally built tools A good grasp of core security fundamentals, including IAM and least privilege, secrets management, networking basics (VPC, DNS, TLS, load balancing) and vulnerability management Comfortable troubleshooting Linux and containerised workloads, and scripting your way out of repetitive tasks Able to manage your own workload, prioritise sensibly, and keep progress visible without being chased Clear communicator, able to explain technical decisions or challenges to non-technical people Beneficial But Not Essential Some Node.js or Ruby experience Cloudflare (DNS, WAF, CDN) Octopus Deploy Experience working within SOC 2 or ISO 27001 controls Observability tooling such as New Relic, Datadog or similar Experience with incident management tooling and blameless post-incident reviews Benefits 30 days annual leave + bank holidays Private Medical Cover with Aviva * 4x salary Death in Service cover with Zurich * Paid maternity & paternity pay after a year of service Salary sacrifice pension matched up to 6% * Flexible working times and location Team lunches, team events, snacks, fruit, nice people After probationary period*

review_candidates.title: Microsoft 365 Administrator – SharePoint & Teams
review_candidates.description: Company Description Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let’s create a world we want to live in. Job Description We are looking for a Microsoft 365 Administrator – SharePoint & Teams to join our IT team. In this role, you will be responsible for the administration, optimization, and support of Microsoft 365 collaboration platforms, with a particular focus on SharePoint Online and Microsoft Teams . You will work closely with internal stakeholders across different countries and business units to ensure a secure, efficient, and user-focused digital workplace. Due to the international scope of the role, working hours are not fixed and may include evening, night, weekend, or rotating shifts , depending on the regions being supported. Your Responsibilities Administration, operation, and continuous development of SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams, including the associated admin centers. Management of SharePoint sites, Teams, channels, Microsoft 365 groups, roles, permissions, and internal and external access. Microsoft specifically includes site and group management, sharing settings, and site administrators as part of SharePoint administration. Design and implementation of governance and lifecycle requirements, for example for site structures, naming conventions, ownership, metadata, archiving, and retention. These topics are also recurring elements in current internal SharePoint initiatives, such as structure, permissions, migration, versioning, and ownership. Configuration and support of Teams policies for collaboration, messaging, meetings, apps, and guest access, as well as monitoring usage and service quality. Execution or support of migrations and automation of recurring administrative tasks using PowerShell and, ideally, Microsoft Graph. Monitoring, incident and problem management, as well as 2nd/3rd-level support, root-cause analysis, documentation, and sustainable knowledge transfer. These responsibilities are also reflected in current market profiles for Microsoft 365 and SharePoint administrators. Advising business departments, gathering technical requirements, and supporting the introduction, training, and adoption of new Microsoft 365 features. Qualifications Completed degree or vocational training in IT, or an equivalent qualification with relevant practical experience. Sound knowledge of administering SharePoint Online and Microsoft Teams in a Microsoft 365 environment. Experience with the Microsoft 365 admin center, Teams admin center, SharePoint admin center, and Microsoft Entra ID, including role, group, and permission concepts. Good understanding of IT security, data protection, and compliance, for example external sharing, sensitivity labels, retention, and data loss prevention. Knowledge of PowerShell, automation, and structured troubleshooting; experience with ITIL-oriented operations processes is an advantage. Current employer profiles particularly identify PowerShell, automation, documentation, secure operations, and analytical problem-solving as key competencies. Analytical and self-directed working style, strong service orientation, and good communication skills in English. Desirable Knowledge Experience with the administration and rollout of Microsoft 365 Copilot, especially with regard to licensing, permissions, data quality, Copilot readiness, and the prevention of oversharing. Copilot and agents use existing Microsoft Graph permissions, sharing settings, and policies; well-maintained SharePoint governance is therefore particularly important. Practical knowledge of Microsoft Copilot Studio and the creation, configuration, testing, and publishing of Copilot agents. Understanding of Power Platform environments, knowledge sources, topics, variables, actions, connectors, Power Automate, and data loss prevention and lifecycle concepts for agents. Additional Information To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working We promote your professional and personal development through individually tailored student mentoring Make valuable contacts within Drees & Sommer and expand your professional network Modern workplace and equipment; Teams meetings and participation in corporate workshops Receive compensation that gives you financial independence during your studies
